slot_operation.menukit.click_take.descri: Clicking this slot picks its items up onto the cursor.
slot_operation.menukit.click_put.descrip: Clicking this slot while holding items puts some or all of them in.
slot_operation.menukit.collect.descripti: Double-clicking a stack sweeps matching items out of this slot.
slot_operation.menukit.drag_fill.descrip: Dragging a held stack across slots can drop part of it into this slot.
slot_operation.menukit.shift_click_out.d: Shift-clicking this slot sends its stack somewhere else.
slot_operation.menukit.shift_click_in.de: A shift-click elsewhere can land items in this slot.
slot_operation.menukit.hotbar_swap.descr: A number key swaps this slot with a hotbar slot.
slot_operation.menukit.offhand_swap.desc: The offhand key swaps this slot with the offhand.
slot_operation.menukit.drop.description: The drop key throws one item out of this slot.
slot_operation.menukit.drop_stack.descri: Control plus the drop key throws the whole stack out of this slot.
slot_operation.menukit.world_pickup.desc: Items picked up from the world can land in this slot, including topping up a stack.
